prompt_strategy.value: We initially started off trying to identify what the item was (an animal or other object), but then we started to use colours in round 2.  That work really well, so we continued with that strategy as we went along through the other rounds. If there was the same colour twice, we came up with a simple word (eg. tall) I know I made one mistake as I couldn't remember if we agreed on yellow or orange in the last round, but I believe that was our only error.

prompt_working_together.name: working_together

prompt_working_together.value: I think we were both shy people (as least I am), so it was a little awkward at the start of the game.  I think I took the lead to get the ball rolling during the practice round, but then we equally gave suggestions as the rounds went on.  There were no debates or arguments.  We were both agreeable to whatever suggestion was made.  I think we worked well together as the game progressed.

prompt_strategy.prompt:
# What strategy did you use during the game?

- How did you decide on your strategy?
- Did you change your strategy? If so, when? How?

Please use at least 200 characters.
prompt_strategy.value: our strategy was to manage time and improve memory by using associations. We associated each image with the closest familiar object and initially used only its first letter. However, we realized this could lead to mistakes, so we changed our strategy to writing out the full words for labels that had simpler spellings. This ensured better accuracy and consistency between team members during the recall phase.
